# Paths agents MUST NOT modify in a contribution pull request.
#
# One glob per line, bash `case`-statement semantics (`*` also matches `/`).
# `#` starts a comment. This file is enforced by:
#   .github/workflows/guard-frozen-files.yml   (server-side, blocks merge)
#   scripts/verify-agent.sh                    (local, fails the run)
#   .claude/hooks/protect-files.sh             (local, courtesy only)
#
# This file is itself frozen: adding an exception requires a maintainer edit.

# The specification and the operating manual.
CONTRIBUTING.md
AGENTS.md
CLAUDE.md
GEMINI.md
CONTRIBUTORS.md
docs/agents/*

# The enforcement layer. Agents must not be able to weaken their own guardrails.
.github/*
.claude/*
.cursor/*
scripts/verify-agent.sh
scripts/guard-pr.mjs
scripts/sync-labels.sh
scripts/install-hooks.sh
scripts/update-contributors.mjs

# Dependency and build configuration.
Cargo.toml
Cargo.lock
build.rs
Dioxus.toml
rust-toolchain*
vendor/*
tools/cargo-prepare/*

# Schema history is append-only and maintainer-owned.
src/data/migrations/*

# Deployment and packaging.
vercel.json
